criterion: which type of entity the encyclopedia article describes

categories.name: Plants
categories.definition: Members of the biological kingdom Plantae, including flowering plants, shrubs, trees, ferns, and aquatic vegetation.

categories.name: People
categories.definition: Individual human beings, including politicians, athletes, artists, writers, and other public figures.

categories.name: Animals
categories.definition: Members of the biological kingdom Animalia, including insects, birds, mammals, fish, and other fauna, excluding humans.

categories.name: Geographic Features
categories.definition: Natural physical formations on Earth such as mountains, rivers, lakes, and capes.

categories.name: Settlements
categories.definition: Human residential areas including cities, towns, villages, and suburbs.

categories.name: Albums
categories.definition: Collections of audio recordings issued as a single item, typically by a musician or band.

categories.name: Films
categories.definition: Motion pictures, including feature films, documentaries, and short films.

categories.name: Books
categories.definition: Written or printed works consisting of pages bound together, including novels, non-fiction, and poetry collections.

categories.name: Vehicles
categories.definition: Machines for transporting passengers or cargo, including automobiles, ships, aircraft, and trains.

categories.name: Buildings and Structures
categories.definition: Man-made constructions including religious buildings, schools, historic houses, and infrastructure like bridges or towers.

categories.name: Organizations
categories.definition: Formal groups of people with a shared purpose, including companies, political parties, and non-profit institutions.

categories.name: Periodicals
categories.definition: Publications issued at regular intervals, such as newspapers, journals, and magazines.
